items.q: I don’t remember Jackie Cain. I vaguely remember that name. What did she do?

ctx.x: The next one that seems to loom large because of a lot of the personnel that were involved with it, some of the folks that you’ve always been – this is Jackie Cain, again on CTI, Time & Love. I don’t know if that’s a memorable . . .
No, I’m not – I don’t remember Jackie Cain. I vaguely remember that name. What did she do?
Day by Day, Time & Love, Summer Song, Summertime, Bachianas Brasileiras #5.
